hero.headline: How we generated business conversations across 8+ industries for a retail strategy & design business
hero.intro: Working at the intersection of retail innovation, physical store design, and customer experience technology, our client helps established retailers and emerging consumer brands rethink how their physical spaces function and how customers discover, touch, and purchase products. Through industry-specific LinkedIn outbound, Myntmore built a multi-vertical pipeline generating **69 hot leads** across retail, consumer brands, automotive, furniture, and event-based audiences.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Retail innovation involves diverse stakeholders with radically divergent priorities: a founder expanding offline is focused on establishing a physical brand presence; a retail head wants to optimise footfall conversion and store unit economics; a marketing leader cares about in-store storytelling and customer experience.

Furthermore, the client's work went far beyond traditional aesthetic interior design. It involved rethinking how customers discover products, compare complex options, and make purchase decisions inside physical spaces.

A generic pitch about “creating better stores” would not communicate that strategic depth. The objective was to **identify businesses actively expanding or revamping physical retail, reach relevant decision-makers, and position the client's expertise around each industry's specific spatial friction points**.

approach.heading: The Approach: Industry-Specific Targeting & Tailored Case Experience
approach.intro: Myntmore developed the LinkedIn outreach around a fundamental reality: __different industries invest in physical retail for completely different reasons__. We tailored messaging and project credentials for each sector:

sectors.description: Addressed considered, high-value purchases where store environments must foster trust and intimate consultation (referenced client's work with Ethera).
Spoke to offline city expansion and maintaining brand integrity across formats (referenced work with Raymond, Arvind, and Nicobar).
Addressed experiential sampling and clinic networks for brands moving beyond digital (referenced Estée Lauder, Colorbar, and Pilgrim).
Focused on simplifying complex product specs and comparison friction (referenced Croma, Hero, Apple, and OnePlus).
Introduced concepts where showrooms function as lifestyle brand hubs rather than static vehicle delivery depots.
Leveraged previous project credentials with Supertails to connect with founders navigating initial offline flagships.

stages.title: 1. Connection Request
stages.description: Short, relevant opening noting a specific company expansion, city launch, or shared industry context.

stages.title: 2. Project Experience
stages.description: Share category-relevant client case study (e.g. Croma for electronics, Supertails for pet care, Ethera for jewellery).

stages.title: 3. Value & Meeting Invitation
stages.description: Introduce a relevant retail article, direct calendar link, or founder voice note to continue the conversation.

insight.heading: Audience Receptivity vs. Commercial Intent
insight.body: The results revealed a clear difference between audiences willing to connect and those actively moving into commercial discussions: **Event-based outreach** generated **16 hot leads** across two campaigns, demonstrating that reaching decision-makers around industry summits creates immediate conversational momentum. Similarly, **Pet Care** delivered an exceptional 8 hot leads from 48 connections (19 responses), proving the immense leverage of category-specific social proof.

whyItWorked.heading: Why It Worked: Connecting Retail Expertise to Industry Priorities
whyItWorked.intro: The strongest campaigns were those where the client's experience could be linked directly to a live business initiative. Key drivers included:

drivers.title: Industry-Specific Messaging:
drivers.description: Outreach was framed around the commercial priorities of each sector rather than a generic interior design pitch.

drivers.title: Category-Relevant Case Studies:
drivers.description: Referencing Supertails for pet care, Ethera for jewellery, and Raymond for fashion gave prospects instant proof of domain competence.

drivers.title: Event & Role Segmentation:
drivers.description: Combining industry targeting with event-based timing and business development roles unlocked outsized conversion efficiency.

drivers.title: Multi-Modal Follow-Ups:
drivers.description: Sharing thought leadership articles, case studies, and personal voice notes provided varied, low-pressure touchpoints that kept conversations alive.

items.title: Category-relevant case studies are non-negotiable

items.title: The right positioning opens doors; relevant conversations turn connections into pipeline
items.body: Focusing on the specific business problem the prospect owns turns cold networking into actionable consulting mandates.
